identity.name: PDPV Tickets
principles: Clarity is Safety: High contrast text always.
Touch First: Big buttons (min 48px height) for quick actions.
Information Hierarchy: Color signals urgency (SLA), not decoration.
Industrial Aesthetics: Dark chrome containers, clean white paper data surfaces.

headings.usage: Page titles, Metric numbers, Modal headers

mono.usage: Ticket IDs, VIN numbers, Timestamps, SLA timers

primary.name: Safety Orange
primary.usage: Primary Buttons, Active States, Key Actions

secondary.name: Mechanic Blue
secondary.usage: Sidebar, Header, Secondary Actions, Dark Mode Backgrounds

cards.style: rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm transition-all hover:shadow-md

inputs.style: h-12 rounded-lg border-2 border-zinc-200 bg-white px-4 transition-colors focus:border-orange-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-0

status_pills.style: inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide ring-1 ring-inset

login_bg.css: absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover opacity-20 mix-blend-overlay

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure orange buttons have white text. Ensure grey text is zinc-600 or darker on white.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Add Chivo, Manrope, and JetBrains Mono links to index.html immediately.
SETUP THEME: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'Safety Orange' and 'Mechanic Blue' colors.
LAYOUT: Use a Sidebar layout for the authenticated app. Login page should be centered with the workshop background.
LANGUAGE: All UI text (labels, buttons, messages) MUST be in PORTUGUESE (PT-PT preferred, PT-BR acceptable).
FORM SPEEDS: Optimize for speed. Auto-focus first input. Allow 'Enter' to submit.
SLA INDICATORS: Use the traffic light system (Green/Yellow/Red) prominently in the Ticket Queue.
ROLES: Ensure the Sidebar navigation filters links based on the user role (Admin, Supervisor, Agent, Finance, Internal).
TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to every interactive element.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, stick to solid colors or subtle noise textures.
Avoid 'AI slop' rounded generic designs. Go for sharp, reliable, industrial shapes.
Always check for component existence in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/ before creating new ones.
